Job Title: Project Manager - ESA Team 
Job Category: Project and Program Management 
Time Type: Full time 
Minimum Clearance Required to Start: Secret 
Employee Type: Regular 
Percentage of Travel Required: Up to 10% 
Type of Travel: Continental US 
* * * 
 The Opportunity
 CACI is seeking experienced Project Managers to support BlueForge Alliance’s (BFA) Enterprise System Architecture (ESA) team through our Submarine Industrial Base Support Program. These assignments provide dedicated project management for the Solutions Marketplace Manager (SMM) OT Data Integrator initiative and Costpoint integration and optimization with Lexell Blue.
 You will independently drive project execution, maintain integrated schedules, coordinate stakeholders, and hold action owners accountable for commitments. Your work will give leadership clear visibility into progress and reduce the need for day-to-day coordination by technical leadership. Technical teams retain responsibility for solution design, development, and implementation. Responsibilities below apply according to the assigned initiative.
 Responsibilities
 Project Management and Delivery
 Own integrated project plans, Work Breakdown Structures (WBS), schedules, milestones, and deliverable trackers. Define task owners and coordinate resource needs and cost estimates with responsible stakeholders.
 Coordinate requirements gathering, working sessions, technical handoffs, testing, validation, and production deployment with business owners, technical teams, and implementation partners.
 Maintain action and decision logs, proactively obtain outstanding requirements, and follow through on commitments. Address blockers promptly and escalate unresolved issues with recommended next steps.
 Manage dependencies and sequencing across concurrent workstreams, balancing resource availability and competing timelines while maintaining progress against agreed priorities.
 Identify project risks and assess the schedule, resource, and cost impacts of issues or proposed changes. Coordinate mitigation actions and obtain decisions from the appropriate stakeholders.
 Use Jira, Smartsheet, and Confluence to organize work, track delivery, and maintain accessible project documentation and decision records.
 Provide consolidated status reporting to leadership and customer stakeholders, highlighting progress, upcoming milestones, schedule impacts, risks, and decisions or escalation support required.
 SMM OT Data Integrator Assignment
 Manage the integration of SMM awardee and shipbuilder data into the Submarine Industrial Base’s (SIB) Independence Foundry environment. The initiative includes seven awardees and two shipbuilders, totaling nine individual integration efforts across three phases.
 Maintain an individual project plan, WBS, schedule, milestones, and deliverable tracker for each performer, supported by a consolidated program roadmap and cross-performer dependency tracking.
 Phase 1 Assessment and Planning: Coordinate kickoffs, stakeholder engagement, Foundry access, requirements gathering, and technical assessments. Oversee preparation of Phase 2 integration scopes and Phase 3 sustainment scopes, including resources, schedules, cost estimates, risks, and dependencies.
 Phase 2 Integration Execution: Coordinate technical integration activities, monitor performer schedules and deliverables, resolve delivery blockers, and track progress against approved scopes.
 Phase 3 Sustainment: Coordinate support requirements and service expectations, track ongoing issues, and monitor sustainment performance with responsible technical and support teams.
 Coordinate SIB, awardees, shipbuilders, and ESA teams to resolve cross-performer dependencies and provide consolidated progress reporting.
 Costpoint Integration and Optimization Assignment
 Manage the integrated Costpoint modernization effort across BFA and Lexell Blue. The assignment covers six identified workstreams: Foundry integration, requisitions, workforce, and three additional workstreams awaiting kickoff.
 Maintain one integrated execution plan covering current development and upcoming workstreams. Sequence planning and resource commitments so new efforts can begin requirements work while others move into development.
 Foundry Integration: Coordinate business rules, data flow requirements, API mapping, and working sessions between BFA and Lexell Blue. Establish development schedules once the required inputs are defined.
 Requisitions: Track approval threshold decisions, workflow configuration, and Deltek defect resolution. Coordinate owners and dependencies and monitor progress against agreed development milestones.
 Workforce: Obtain outstanding specification requirements, organize follow-up sessions, and coordinate development estimates and completion forecasts with the responsible teams.
 Additional Workstreams: Coordinate the kickoff and requirements planning for three new workstreams, confirm resource availability, and incorporate their milestones and dependencies into the integrated schedule.
 Qualifications
 Required
 Active SECRET Clearance .
 5–10 years of relevant project management experience with a Bachelor’s Degree; additional years of experience may substitute for the degree requirement.
 Demonstrated experience owning the delivery of complex technical projects involving multiple concurrent workstreams, external partners, and cross-functional teams.
 Ability to work independently, drive schedules and commitments, obtain stakeholder decisions, and escalate delivery risks without continuous intervention from technical leadership.
 Experience developing integrated project plans, WBS, schedules, cost estimates, and milestone and deliverable trackers, and managing resource and dependency constraints.
 Experience using Jira, Smartsheet, and Confluence for project coordination, progress tracking, issue management, and documentation.
 Working knowledge of requirements management, systems or data integration, testing, validation, deployment, and transition to ongoing support.
 Strong analytical and communication skills, including the ability to translate technical discussions into clear actions and explain delivery status and decisions to diverse stakeholders.
 Working knowledge of Deltek Costpoint and experience coordinating enterprise systems or business workflow enhancements.
 Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or equivalent project management credentials.
 Desired
 Experience coordinating Foundry data integration projects, external data providers, or technical delivery across multiple performer organizations.
 Experience managing Costpoint or other enterprise resource planning (ERP) integrations, workflow configuration, and vendor-led development initiatives.
 Familiarity with API and data mapping requirements, approval workflows, or requisition and workforce processes sufficient to coordinate technical and business stakeholders.
 Experience supporting Other Transaction (OT)

Headquartered in Miami, Florida, and supported by a team of more than 1,200 professionals worldwide, we help clients plan, execute, and optimize large-scale capital programs.

 Consertus is seeking a Project Manager to represent the Owner’s interests on K–12 school construction and renovation projects—from early planning and procurement, through preconstruction, and continuing through closeout. This role owns the overall delivery of assigned projects — schedule, budget, contract administration, and stakeholder coordination — working closely with the on-site Construction Manager, architects, engineers, and district facilities staff. The ideal candidate is organized, proactive, and comfortable communicating with district stakeholders while keeping projects on track. This position reports to the Program Manager.
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Serve as the owner's representative for assigned K-12 projects, overseeing scope, schedule, and budget from pre-construction through closeout
 Develop and maintain project schedules, budgets, and cash flow projections, updating regularly as the project progresses
 Administer contracts, including review and processing of submittals, RFIs, change orders, and pay applications
 Coordinate with architects, engineers, and consultants to resolve design questions and ensure design intent is carried through construction
 Partner with the on-site Construction Manager to align field activity with the overall project plan and address issues as they arise
 Communicate project status, risks, and milestones to district stakeholders, facilities staff, and the Program Manager
 Support procurement and bidding processes, including scope development, bid review, and contractor qualification
 Ensure compliance with public bidding requirements, prevailing wage, and district procurement policies
 Coordinate project phasing and sequencing around the school calendar to minimize disruption to students and staff
 Manage risk identification and mitigation planning at the project level
 Track and manage project closeout, including punch list resolution, as-builts, warranties, and final documentation
 Prepare and present project status reports and updates for internal and district review
 Qualifications/Requirements: 
 Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Architecture, Engineering, or a related field (preferred)
 5+ years of project management experience in construction; K-12 or public education project experience preferred
 Strong understanding of construction contracts, scheduling, and cost/budget management
 Familiarity with public bidding, prevailing wage, and school construction requirements a plus
 Proficiency with project management and scheduling software (e.g., Procore, Primavera P6, MS Project)
 Strong written and verbal communication skills, with experience coordinating across owners, designers, and contractors
 Excellent organizational, problem-solving, and time-management skills
 Excellent interpersonal/soft skills is a must
 Ability to read and interpret construction drawings and specifications
 PMP certification a plus
 Additional Requirements / Skills / Working Hours / Compensation Range: 
 Ability to attend occasional evening meetings with district staff or stakeholders as needed
 Willingness to travel between school sites  on a regular basis. Some overnight stays may be required. Company reimbursement for milage and travel applies.
 Valid driver's license required
 Salary Range: $110,000.00 - $155,000.00
 What's In It For You: 
 Company-paid life and disability insurance
 Optional benefits like pet insurance, legal, and supplemental health plans
 401(k) with day-one eligibility, 3% safe harbor, plus up to 2.5% company match
 Generous time off: 10 paid holidays and PTO starting at 15 days, growing up to 25
